props.text: A scenic loop from the waterfront to the Golden Gate, with time to eat, walk and take photos. Tap a pin or a stop for details.
Coffee and pastries in the 1898 market hall on the bay.
Coffee and pastries in the 1898 market hall on the bay.
Climb Telegraph Hill for Depression-era murals and a 360° view.
Walk down the crooked block of brick switchbacks and hydrangeas.
Sea lions at Pier 39 and clam chowder in a sourdough bowl.

props.query: Palace of Fine Arts San Francisco

props.text: A Roman-style rotunda reflected in a quiet lagoon.
Walk out to the first tower for the classic view back at the city.
The Japanese Tea Garden and the Conservatory of Flowers.
End with the Painted Ladies and the skyline at sunset.
Times are estimates and include about 20 minutes to get to each next stop. Cable cars run every 10 minutes or so; a Muni day pass covers them and the buses.
